steps.sql: SELECT LEFT('abcdef',3) AS l,RIGHT('abcdef',3) AS r,LEFT(N'abcdef',3) AS nl,RIGHT(N'abcdef',3) AS nr
SELECT LEFT(CAST('x' AS CHAR(10)),3) AS l,RIGHT(CAST(N'x' AS NCHAR(10)),3) AS r
DECLARE @s VARCHAR(10)='abcdef',@n INT=3; SELECT LEFT(@s,3) AS a,RIGHT(@s,@n) AS b
SELECT LEFT('abc',0) AS a,RIGHT('abc',20) AS b,RIGHT(NULL,3) AS c,LEFT('abc',NULL) AS d
SELECT LEFT(CAST('abc' AS VARCHAR(MAX)),2) AS a,RIGHT(CAST(N'abc' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),2) AS b
SELECT LEFT(12345,2) AS a,RIGHT(CAST(12345 AS BIGINT),2) AS b,LEFT(0x008041,2) AS c
SELECT LEFT('abcdef',2.9) AS a,RIGHT('abcdef','2') AS b
SELECT LEFT(N'🦆xy',1) AS a,RIGHT(N'x🦆',1) AS b
